svg.title: PI and MPC control of a thermal system

cc:Work.dc:title: PI and MPC control of a thermal system
cc:Work.dc:description: Four sets of temperature and heating power trajectories for PI and MPC with an ideal model, measured and unknown thermal loads, and parameter mismatch.
